integrity: Formula and finite corroboration provided; analytic proof supplies infinite claims. No independent validation or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to three independent normalized-arclength boundary samples from Euclidean rectangles. Square special value is prior. No monotonicity claim. Historical priority beyond examined sources is unverified, and one relevant 1994 article was accessible only by abstract. Date of first post of a relevant 2012 answer is known, but its later edit history was not reconstructed.
title: Acute-triangle law and a seven-halves transition for random rectangle-boundary triples
